𓄿	<b>vulture</b> · G1 · <i>[ꜣ]</i> · Egyptian vulture<br>The vulture opens its beak and what comes out is barely a sound — ꜣ, the catch in the throat. Big bird, smallest of noises: that mismatch is the memory.<br><i>qr bḏꜣ</i> — "heating the bread-molds" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:2PGN6CK4QBEKNEP7VZX3WBVXSY:IBUBd8PxTjqTAkthkbPkGuGBHcI, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓇋	<b>reed</b> · M17 · <i>[j]</i> · flowering reed<br>A single reed bows its flowered head — as slight as the sound it writes. Where the wind barely moves through the marsh, the voice barely moves through j.<br><i>Mnj</i> — Meni — a man's name (approximate) (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:3FCGH3KKMBDVBCHD4EIIYXVJ3A:IBUBd7PkbU9E5kZNsHhsrmn2Rwc, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓏭	<b>pair</b> · Z4 · <i>[y]</i> · two strokes<br>A pair of ticks: y is j twice, and the scribes kept the arithmetic — two little strokes instead of two whole reeds. Count the marks, hear the doubling.<br><i>tm rn≡k</i> — "your name is no more" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:A2PTGDCYB5E4XK6OORW6V4QHOE:IBUBd51vtWV1sE3hgOxarVpeWf8, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓂝	<b>forearm</b> · D36 · <i>[ꜥ]</i> · forearm<br>The forearm reaches out flat — the sound ꜥ comes from just as deep as an arm is long. It waits inside the sun-god's own name: Rꜥw, mouth-arm-sun.<br><i>Rꜥw-wr</i> — Ra-wer — "Ra is great" (approximate) (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:3SOT6RKYAJBX7IYKESFMZXREDM:IBUBdyvvHw5gX0VdlhJYRxrccqw, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓅱	<b>chick</b> · G43 · <i>[w]</i> · quail chick<br>The chick says w — the small round "oo" of a small round bird. Wherever a word needs that vowel-ish glide, the chick trots in on its two drawn legs.<br><i>wt,j</i> — "the embalmer" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:3TSEPTYRMBEHZKKCC4SXVWMSIE:IBUBd52Rp691nUHmlpfkUsUQBqU, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓏲	<b>coil</b> · Z7 · <i>[w]</i> · coil (cursive quail chick)<br>The coil is a chick drawn by a scribe with no time: body, beak, and feet collapsed into one curl. When you meet the spiral, hear the same w — the bird is in there, compressed.<br><i>mw≡n pw</i> — "it is our water" (urn:nabu:aes:sawlit:GJA5VMSJDFAOPG6TP6ZYY3KCRI:IBUBdz4GvuvTV0SLspFbeDzffeo, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓃀	<b>leg</b> · D58 · <i>[b]</i> · lower leg and foot<br>One leg, standing its ground — b as in bear the weight. Two legs walk; one leg holds. When negation needs a firm stance (bn, "not"), this is the leg it stands on.<br><i>j:ḫr sbn</i> — "fallen, sliding away" — said of the god's enemy (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgraeberspzt:XH7T6KK7WRE7TB5GUFPKZLMOPQ:IBUBdxBipvFMG0ylvsWUHGXoK7o, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓊪	<b>stool</b> · Q3 · <i>[p]</i> · reed mat or stool<br>A stool is the simplest thing that holds you up — and pw, "it is," is the simplest sentence that holds a claim up. Square seat, square sound, load-bearing both.<br><i>mw pw</i> — "it is water" (urn:nabu:aes:sawlit:3W45TQYQ3RCX5DXZ7DIZ43JWNQ:IBUBd5xZ0i0MAUPIoKrsdwrJETo, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓆑	<b>viper</b> · I9 · <i>[f]</i> · horned viper<br>The viper hisses f — a snake sound if ever there was one — and then coils at the end of words as "his": his house, his majesty, his life. Small, horned, and possessive.<br><i>ḏd≡f</i> — "he says" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:AHWOVKY54FDQ3IG3XIPVIBY7DM:IBUBdQNyVsBq10VRri8gWAqV3jo, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓅓	<b>owl</b> · G17 · <i>[m]</i> · owl<br>The owl stares out of the wall at you, and you cannot pass a line without meeting it — m is "in," and the owl is IN everything. Face-on bird, everywhere: that is m.<br><i>m ꜣz</i> — "do not hurry" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:3CYQDCHYP5FNFPWZI5CSROZUAQ:IBUBd7brvDZIoUzRpdguU4cR2xU, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓈖	<b>ripple</b> · N35 · <i>[n]</i> · ripple of water<br>One ripple joins two banks — and n joins two words: "the spell OF water," "give it TO him." Wherever Egyptian needs a little bridge, a line of water runs under it.<br><i>rʾ n mw</i> — "a spell of water" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtempelbib:QQUPR5AIGZCXTA4YSXKA6ILTAM:IBUBd98zcEGyikWLm52Te9NxGEw, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓂋	<b>mouth</b> · D21 · <i>[r]</i> · mouth<br>The mouth is an open oval — the shape your own lips make saying r. Everything spoken in this script starts here: the spell is a "mouth," and the mouth writes itself.<br><i>rʾ n mw</i> — "a spell of water" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtempelbib:QQUPR5AIGZCXTA4YSXKA6ILTAM:IBUBd98zcEGyikWLm52Te9NxGEw, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓉔	<b>shelter</b> · O4 · <i>[h]</i> · reed shelter<br>A shelter of reeds barely holds back the wind — and h is barely a sound, just breath through an open door. Light building, light letter.<br><i>tw≡tw hꜣy.ṱ r mw</i> — "one goes down to the water" (urn:nabu:aes:sawlit:IQTYOQXOPVCALF3EWJIZIXLNZU:IBUBd2y4WkjlHE0kn2w1qJt4y4w, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓎛	<b>wick</b> · V28 · <i>[ḥ]</i> · twisted wick<br>The wick is h with a twist — literally: the plain breath wound tighter, ready to burn. Where h is an open door, ḥ is a braided cord.<br><i>ḥwi̯ mḥꜥ</i> — "beating the flax" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:LA52ETBPSBG7NAVV4L7HMTI26A:IBUBd92d0kl2YENfkaxOX7knJ9c, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓐍	<b>sieve</b> · AA1 · <i>[ḫ]</i> · sieve? placenta?<br>A sieve rasps when you shake it — grain against mesh, the sound of ḫ. Whether or not the Egyptians drew a sieve, the hatched disc scratches, and that scratch is the letter.<br><i>fsw Wnḫ,w</i> — "the cook Wenechu" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:TCT7T7R2FBBWHKBPYYLTK3TWR4:IBUBd7PCYgGV4k5ckHGQomnpN9E, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓄡	<b>belly</b> · F32 · <i>[ẖ]</i> · animal's belly and tail<br>The belly is the soft side — and ẖ is the soft rasp, underneath its hard cousin the way a belly is under a back. Soft picture, soft sound; and "son of his body" wears it.<br><i>zꜣ≡f n ẖ,t≡f Rꜥw-wr</i> — "his bodily son, Ra-wer" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:SFHXXMQOD5BQXBNVA5LYKTI6QQ:IBUBd0DxaJECXkhYjvjlrTQXSiY, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓊃	<b>bolt</b> · O34 · <i>[z]</i> · door bolt<br>The bolt slides with a buzz — zzz — straight across its door. One long bar, one flat sound; when a word keeps the old z, this is the bar that locks it in.<br><i>sn tꜣ n nb-tꜣ,wj</i> — "kissing the earth for the Lord of the Two Lands" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:EIKGCKAHNZGOTKGBXIR2SFEYWU:IBUBd6hlDXaq3U8ygzfYpV2CjOY, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓋴	<b>cloth</b> · S29 · <i>[s]</i> · folded cloth<br>The cloth hangs in folds that hiss when they slide — s. And put the cloth in front of a verb and it dresses the verb up into a causing: ꜥnḫ live, s-ꜥnḫ bring to life.<br><i>sꜥnḫ</i> — "the sculptor" — literally, "he who makes live" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:Y2HZBORZEVBELK7FCF5B37I3U4:IBUBd7qytTen0EjxuszCxZlWTcQ, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓈙	<b>pool</b> · N37 · <i>[š]</i> · pool of water<br>A pool asks for quiet — sh — and the sign is exactly the calm rectangle you'd hush someone beside. Flat water, flat sound.<br><i>jri̯ š≡k rf</i> — "do your work, then!" 𓈎	<b>slope</b> · N29 · <i>[q]</i> · slope of a hill<br>Climbing a sand slope takes effort from deep in the chest — and so does q, the k with weight behind it. Plain k walks on flat ground; q climbs.<br><i>qr bḏꜣ</i> — "heating the bread-molds" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:2PGN6CK4QBEKNEP7VZX3WBVXSY:IBUBd8PxTjqTAkthkbPkGuGBHcI, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓎡	<b>basket</b> · V31 · <i>[k]</i> · basket with handle<br>The basket has a handle because it is meant to be YOURS to carry — and ≡k is exactly that: your name, your house, your heart, each with the little basket hooked on. Its mirror twin V31A faces the other way.<br><i>Jr,w-kꜣ</i> — Iru-ka — a man's name (approximate) (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:DL2RSV5A3BFCXMRISIT2I6IOKA:IBUBd9A6c0edRkbMhoImeTpVF3M, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓎼	<b>stand</b> · W11 · <i>[g]</i> · jar stand<br>A stand with no jar on it is the picture of wanting — and Egyptian agrees: gꜣ, "lack," is spelled with this very sign. The rack holds the sound g the way it holds a jar: snugly, whatever gets set on it.<br><i>wni̯≡n ꜥnḫ m gꜣ≡k</i> — "we have grown weary of life in your absence" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:45APBFH7ENHZVHELL64L5XSRBY:IBUBdyZZXpxImU00kiEqVcYpWLQ, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓏏	<b>loaf</b> · X1 · <i>[t]</i> · loaf of bread<br>The loaf is daily bread — you will not read three words without one. Every feminine word ends in this little bun; count the loaves on any wall and you are counting the grammar.<br><i>ḏꜣ,t</i> — "the grey crane" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:CIL2AO35INF2DFDTQ2NG7TEVFU:IBUBd6xLgjMlu0mzoZpwkXg8JKE, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓍿	<b>tether</b> · V13 · <i>[ṯ]</i> · tethering rope<br>The tether is t with a twist of rope on it — ṯ. Where the loaf's plain t sits still, the tether-sound tugs; it holds the enclitic "you" (ṯw) the way a rope holds a calf.<br><i>wni̯ ṯw</i> — "hurry, you!" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:RHA4B6LY25ABLG2ZCL4OWGL47A:IBUBd44UPGt3wEjcmDbjE3yZew4, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓂧	<b>hand</b> · D46 · <i>[d]</i> · hand<br>The hand does — and d is the doing sound: ḏd "say" carries it, and every craftsman's caption keeps it busy. Where the arm reaches, the bare hand works.<br><i>dw sjn</i> — "applying the clay" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:D6W7KCYSB5BZPNGLGV53DHHC4A:IBUBdxkYkpwLcEhHgGHCQiLfSWE, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓆓	<b>cobra</b> · I10 · <i>[ḏ]</i> · cobra at rest<br>The cobra speaks first: ḏd, "say," begins with it, so every storyteller's "then His Majesty said…" starts with a snake. Watch for the coil and hood — someone is about to talk.<br><i>ḏd ḥm≡f</i> — "His Majesty says" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawhistbiospzt:XSMWRMUR4NB6XEXIJVRVHJK2R4:IBUCENVQliJVjULwvCZ2iqEPMrs, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓉐	<b>house</b> · O1 · <i>[pr]</i> · house (ground-plan)<br>A house seen from above — walls squared, one doorway open. Everything domestic starts at this plan, and everything that goes forth leaves through its one gap.<br><i>pr≡f ḫf.y</i> — "his house is destroyed" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:2Z3OHH5EKZEUTAFMAIWR2PXTGE:IBUBd7UkuKHYoUOMgMmYlHKqeLY, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓏤	<b>stroke</b> · Z1 · <i>—</i> · the word-sign stroke — 'this sign means what it shows'<br>The stroke is the script pointing at its own picture: "yes, really, THE THING." One small mark, and a sound-sign turns back into the object it always drew.<br><i>rʾ n mw</i> — "a spell of water" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtempelbib:QQUPR5AIGZCXTA4YSXKA6ILTAM:IBUBd98zcEGyikWLm52Te9NxGEw, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓂻	<b>walking</b> · D54 · <i>—</i> · walking legs — classifier for motion words<br>Walking legs at the end of a word are the script's stage direction: exit, moving. If you see them, something just went somewhere — read back to find out what.<br><i>Wsjr ꜥq≡f r≡tn</i> — "Osiris — he enters against you" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:ADO4HPZ7DNBFPOKZ4AGZWM45HM:IBUBd2wdh4wirkJkopavDGHCUPQ, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓍷	<b>cartouche</b> · V10 · <i>—</i> · the cartouche — rope ring around royal names<br>The cartouche is a rope fence around the most valuable words in Egypt. Wherever you see the ring, a king or queen lives inside it — the frame is the crown.<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓇳	<b>sun</b> · N5 · <i>[rꜥ]</i> · sun disc; the god Ra<br>The sun needs one circle — the simplest drawing of the most worshipped thing in Egypt. When time or divinity enters a word, the disc rises at its end.<br><i>jtn≡f jtn≡k</i> — "his disc — your disc" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:7TAGNLXXXRH5LFEBRCBEKPXU4E:IBUBd1bocB5iCUkHqkj2AJXLIp4, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓇓	<b>sedge</b> · M23 · <i>[sw]</i> · sedge plant; writes nswt, king<br>One sedge stem, and the whole south of Egypt stands behind it — the plant that means the king. And when a sentence needs a light "he," it borrows the royal plant for a commoner's pronoun.<br><i>sw m s,t≡f</i> — "he is in his place" (urn:nabu:aes:sawlit:MTBRL3MIIJDKXAOF2336WRLMZA:IBUBd5NmCHOe70QOmEFGRHm2dc4, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓊵	<b>offering</b> · R4 · <i>[ḥtp]</i> · loaf on a reed mat — offering, peace<br>An offering is bread on a mat — nothing more is needed, and the sign never adds more. Where the loaf rests, there is peace: ḥtp is both the gift and the calm it buys.<br><i>ḥtp-ḏi̯ nswt</i> — "an offering which the king gives" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:3NTVXEHQCRDYXH4ATYZ34LI3EE:IBUBd4bfBgCc7UBnlsf3s9iPQgw, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓏙	<b>given loaf</b> · X8 · <i>[ḏi̯]</i> · conical loaf held out — give<br>The given loaf is the present with the giver cropped out — just the bread, mid-air, changing hands. Wherever gods or kings give life, bread, or breath, this little cone does the giving.<br><i>ḥtp-ḏi̯ nswt</i> — "an offering which the king gives" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:3NTVXEHQCRDYXH4ATYZ34LI3EE:IBUBd4bfBgCc7UBnlsf3s9iPQgw, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓂓	<b>ka</b> · D28 · <i>[kꜣ]</i> · two raised arms — the ka, the life-force<br>The ka lifts both arms — to receive, to embrace, to say here I am. 𓏠	<b>board</b> · Y5 · <i>[mn]</i> · game board with pieces — mn<br>The board holds its pieces steady in their squares — mn, firmly placed. 𓎟	<b>lord</b> · V30 · <i>[nb]</i> · wicker basket — lord; every<br>The lord owns whatever the basket holds — and the basket holds everything, which is why the same sign also means "every." 𓁷	<b>face</b> · D2 · <i>[ḥr]</i> · human face — face; upon<br>The face looks straight out at you, like the owl — and "upon" is where a face points. Turn your face to a task and you are ḥr it: the preposition is a gaze.<br><i>mj,tt ḥr(,j) mw pw</i> — "the same holds for him who is upon the water" (urn:nabu:aes:sawlit:L4M2NZM2YZAZRBIKQQBAVX743U:IBUBd74JkfHjjEYAgTDDunKKnF4, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓄟	<b>skins</b> · F31 · <i>[ms]</i> · three fox skins tied — born of<br>Three skins knotted together — offspring bundled to a mother, the litter in one tie. Every royal name that ends in "-mose" or "-messes" was born through this sign.<br><i>msi̯≡tw≡k mj msi̯.w Jtn</i> — "you are born like Aten is born" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:XC6QAUTJCVHPLDGRSYE6AQR4AM:IBUBd8adyZ8nckyKkFUqMLPRlds, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓅭	<b>duck</b> · G39 · <i>[zꜣ]</i> · pintail duck — son<br>The duck paddles with its brood behind it — and in the script the brood is the point: son of, daughter of, child of. One duck, and a family tree starts.<br><i>zꜣ,t≡f S,t≡s-kꜣ,w</i> — "his daughter, Setes-kau" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:JLBCEUYJHNDBZOWRFVBJ52HIXU:IBUBd3Uo1rMncUEukkXQWYGwYX4, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓏌	<b>pot</b> · W24 · <i>[nw]</i> · round pot — nw<br>The pot is round as the mouth saying "nw." Small, common, easy to overlook — like the grammar it helps spell: the biggest word it lives in is "I."<br><i>Ḥnk,t-j</i> — Henketi — "the offerer" (approximate) (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:63IPBDEULBAR3JVWA4KUNTUI6Q:IBUBdyt6uPCSK01ClozVkRAt8i4, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓀀	<b>person</b> · A1 · <i>—</i> · seated man — classifier: man, I<br>The person sits at the end of a word like a signature: a human is meant here — and when the text says "I," the little seated figure IS the speaker, drawn in person.<br><i>ḏd≡j n m mjn</i> — "To whom shall I speak today?" (urn:nabu:aes:sawlit:XZIG534KFVGODK6N7G5RP7SSDE:IBUBdyJshy17akYyoQdiOwvfd84, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓁐	<b>woman</b> · B1 · <i>—</i> · seated woman — classifier: woman<br>The woman sits at the close of a name and settles the question the sounds leave open: a woman is meant. Wherever a mother, daughter, or goddess is written, she sits there in person.<br><i>Ḥḥ,w Ḥḥ,t kꜣ≡tw r-rʾ≡sn</i> — "Huh and Hauhet — so one says of them" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtempelbib:L7D5AZI5SRBY7KDHPSKJURRZK4:IBUBd2sv6DkFSUBlmWYInjkWWlQ, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓀁	<b>hand to mouth</b> · A2 · <i>—</i> · man with hand to mouth — classifier: eat, speak, think<br>Hand to mouth covers every traffic through the lips — food in, words out, and the thoughts behind both. If a word wears this figure, something is happening at the mouth or in the mind behind it.<br><i>swr≡k jm≡sn</i> — "may you drink from them" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:3ENAFOSI3ZCLJE7XZDY4TZ3WNI:IBUBd8WSKUTUuEo2guBje8CydTk, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓏥	<b>plural</b> · Z2 · <i>—</i> · three strokes — classifier: plural<br>Count the plural: one stroke is the thing itself, three strokes are things beyond counting. When gods, names, or loaves multiply, these three ticks do the multiplying.<br><i>nn rn.pl≡tn</i> — "your names shall not be" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtempelbib:Q4OD2GDHL5HIXHU3MGUZ3PAMVM:IBUBd5fCxiuh40LfrVMQR1XNMws, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓏛	<b>idea</b> · Y1 · <i>—</i> · papyrus roll tied shut — classifier: abstract idea<br>An idea lives in a closed book: the scribes' own admission that some things exist only on paper. When a word wears the tied roll, the thing it names is thinkable, not touchable.<br><i>jw≡k dr.ṱ dm.ṱ</i> — "you are driven off, annihilated" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:A2PTGDCYB5E4XK6OORW6V4QHOE:IBUBd6i2gM9AuU1GjDbiWGWhj68, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓅪	<b>smallness</b> · G37 · <i>—</i> · sparrow — classifier: small, bad, weak<br>Smallness with feathers: where the good gods get falcons, trouble gets the sparrow. If a word carries this bird, the news is bad, weak, or shrinking — brace before you translate. Its lookalike, the swallow of G36, means the opposite: watch the tail.<br><i>nn wnn≡k dm.ṱ</i> — "you shall not exist, being annihilated" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:A2PTGDCYB5E4XK6OORW6V4QHOE:IBUBd4WnAWIbCEq9rLuvQoItCB4, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓋹	<b>life</b> · S34 · <i>[ꜥnḫ]</i> · sandal strap? knot? — the ankh: life<br>Life is the sign you already knew before you could read: the ankh. Loop, bar, and stem — whatever it once drew, forty centuries agreed on what it gives.<br><i>ꜥnḫ≡f m ꜥnḫ Rꜥw jm</i> — "may he live on that whereby Ra lives" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtempelbib:QQUPR5AIGZCXTA4YSXKA6ILTAM:IBUBd5wVvVh9hE8JrxSE4SSIYGY, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓄤	<b>beautiful</b> · F35 · <i>[nfr]</i> · heart and windpipe? — nefer: good, beautiful<br>Beautiful is a lute-shaped charm of a sign — whatever organ it drew, it reads as everything Egypt wanted to be: good, lovely, complete. Queens wore it in their names like jewelry.<br><i>Nfr rn-ꜥꜣ≡f</i> — "Nefer is his great name" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:6CRPOC6MRRG45B75JES3ABTHZE:IBUBd9muUqQ92ErXjUoKSTj9VwE, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓆣	<b>scarab</b> · L1 · <i>[ḫpr]</i> · scarab beetle — kheper: become, transform<br>The scarab rolls its ball and life comes out of it — becoming, engineered by a beetle. Every "become," every transformation, every Khepri-name carries this insect.<br><i>nn ḫpr≡tn nn wn≡tn</i> — "you shall not become; you shall not be" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:A2PTGDCYB5E4XK6OORW6V4QHOE:IBUBdwS3H2bLl0S1n5N8U9CLN1A, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓊹	<b>flag</b> · R8 · <i>[nṯr]</i> · temple flag on a pole — netjer: god<br>The flag marks the god's address — you cannot see a god, but you can see where one is flown. Wherever divinity enters a word, the temple flag goes up.<br><i>jw≡k m nṯr pri̯ m nṯr</i> — "you are a god, come forth from a god" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:45APBFH7ENHZVHELL64L5XSRBY:IBUBd8Y5Y422G0apoG4ESTPBbac, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓃭	<b>lion</b> · E23 · <i>[rw]</i> · recumbent lion — rw<br>The lion at rest still owns the ground — and it owns two alphabets' worth of sounds: Egyptian rw at home, and the borrowed L whenever Greeks came visiting. Decipherment walked in on its back.<br><i>ꜥꜣpp ḫr qrnr</i> — "Apophis is fallen — the Qerner-snake!" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtotenlit:2Z3OHH5EKZEUTAFMAIWR2PXTGE:IBUBdwKURW8Z1EbXp44g88XV2ug, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
𓍯	<b>lasso</b> · V4 · <i>[wꜣ]</i> · lasso — wa<br>The lasso flies far before it lands — wꜣ is the far-away sound, the first half of "way." A rope thrown toward the horizon: distance, drawn.<br><i>Jmi̯,t-wꜣj</i> — Imit-wai — a woman's name (approximate) (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:6I3FE4B2CNBZ5DQZJV6FF6V24M:IBUBdyooTyWwe0DClagirkjg6fA, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-101
